personal.title: Senior Flutter Developer
personal.summary:
Senior Flutter Developer with 4+ years of experience building scalable mobile applications across SaaS, hospitality, government, and blockchain domains. Strong expertise in Flutter architecture, GraphQL integration, monorepo development, and CI/CD automation. Experienced in delivering production-ready applications published on the App Store and Google Play with a focus on maintainability, performance, and clean architecture.
Strong English reading & listening comprehension, with hands-on experience writing technical documentation in English. Actively leverages AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini for research; Claude for custom development skills, MCP workflows, and Figma-to-code generation) to accelerate delivery.
